params.topic: Veikkausliiga 2019-2026 missing per-fixture official round and venue facts
questions: Fill only the unresolved Veikkausliiga fixture rows needed for official_round, fixture identity, kickoff and venue/venue city when explicitly evidenced. Prioritize the 2019-2025 rows and 2026 continuation rounds 23-32 identified in the prior audit.

Use the official Veikkausliiga schedule/archive and/or Palloliitto Tulospalvelu as primary sources. WorldFootball or another complete explicit schedule may be used as a cross-check, never as an inferred round source. Preserve moved matches using the published KIERROS label; never derive official_round from date order, row order, scores, standings, odds, or team occurrence count.

For every returned row include competition_key, season, fixture_key, date, kickoff, kickoff_timezone, home_team, away_team, official_round, venue, city, status, source_name, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256, and evidence_notes. Keep rows with NULL fields and list them in unresolved_queue.

Do not invent or infer meeting_number, first/second meeting, double_round_robin, Qimen charts, palaces, relations, odds, probabilities, Outcome, Review, Gold, or model conclusions. If no source defines meeting_number, return NULL/unavailable with the reason.

Return audit totals by season with expected, discovered, complete, partial, and missing counts, and distinguish complete row-level evidence from page-level or sample-only evidence. A page summary or three samples is insufficient for a row to be complete.

notes: Evidence-only supplement. Do not write formal Snapshot/Outcome/Review/Gold or SQLite records. meeting_number remains NULL/unavailable unless an explicit authoritative definition is found.
